info.title: Project Connect Consumer API
info.description: Consumer API (`/api/v1`). Success responses use `{ "data": … }`; errors use the stable `{ "error": { code, message, correlationId } }` envelope. Clients branch on `error.code`.

get.summary: Public app bootstrap state (ADR-076); account only with a valid access token

post.summary: Start a phone verification; identical response for every accepted number
Verify the code; signs in an existing account or returns a registration token
Create the account from a registration token and date of birth (server age authority)
End the sign-in that owns this refresh token (always 204)
Revoke every session of the authenticated user

get.summary: Own-account projection (masked phone, computed age; never DOB)

patch.summary: Update onboarding profile fields (first name, gender); advances onboarding
Set the current city (manual selection; server derives metro/country). Allowed from the LOCATION onboarding step onward; advances LOCATION → INTENT

get.summary: Top-level intent options; DATING and the dating policy version only while the Dating kill switch is on

put.summary: Replace the active non-dating intents (DATING changes only via dating consent). Allowed from INTENT onward; advances INTENT → LANGUAGE
Affirmatively opt in to Dating for the current policy version; records consent and activates DATING atomically. Idempotent

delete.summary: Withdraw dating consent and deactivate DATING atomically. Never blocked (kill switch, onboarding step or intent minimum). Idempotent

get.summary: Selectable launch cities (bounded taxonomy; no coordinates)

CorrelationId.name: X-Correlation-ID
CorrelationId.description: Optional client correlation ID (8–64 chars of [A-Za-z0-9-]); echoed back.

IdempotencyKey.name: Idempotency-Key
IdempotencyKey.description: UUID per user submission; reuse it for network retries of the same submission. A different payload with the same key is rejected.

Error403.description: Account or feature not available (ACCOUNT_NOT_ACTIVE, DATING_NOT_ELIGIBLE)

Error422.description: Business rule rejection (OTP_INCORRECT, AGE_NOT_ELIGIBLE, CITY_NOT_AVAILABLE, INTENT_REQUIRED)
